description: Source file implementing the ModuleIR class and related functions for handling IR representations, including adding types, functions, symbols, and retrieving compilation unit paths within the header_checker::repr namespace.

classes.name: ModuleIR
classes.description: Represents a module containing IR types, functions, symbols, and related metadata, with methods to add and query these elements.

methods.name: AddLinkableMessage
methods.description: Adds a linkable message (type, function, etc.) to the module based on its kind.

methods.name: AddElfSymbol
methods.description: Adds an ELF symbol (function or object) to the module.

methods.name: AddFunction
methods.description: Adds a function IR to the module if it is in exported headers.

methods.name: AddGlobalVariable
methods.description: Adds a global variable IR to the module if it is in exported headers.

methods.name: AddRecordType
methods.description: Adds a record type IR to the module if it is in exported headers.

methods.name: AddFunctionType
methods.description: Adds a function type IR to the module if it is in exported headers.

methods.name: AddEnumType
methods.description: Adds an enum type IR to the module if it is in exported headers.

methods.name: AddLvalueReferenceType
methods.description: Adds an lvalue reference type IR to the module if it is in exported headers.

methods.name: AddRvalueReferenceType
methods.description: Adds an rvalue reference type IR to the module if it is in exported headers.

methods.name: AddQualifiedType
methods.description: Adds a qualified type IR to the module if it is in exported headers.

methods.name: AddArrayType
methods.description: Adds an array type IR to the module if it is in exported headers.

methods.name: AddPointerType
methods.description: Adds a pointer type IR to the module if it is in exported headers.

methods.name: AddBuiltinType
methods.description: Adds a builtin type IR to the module.

methods.name: AddElfFunction
methods.description: Adds an ELF function symbol to the module.

methods.name: AddElfObject
methods.description: Adds an ELF object symbol to the module.

methods.name: GetCompilationUnitPath
methods.description: Retrieves the compilation unit path for a given type IR.

methods.name: IsLinkableMessageInExportedHeaders
methods.description: Checks if a linkable message is in the set of exported headers.
